coverage: 14 regions; 76 districts plus Prague as a special district-level equivalent; all 6,258 RÚIAN local polygons including four military areas. The municipal source count is a register snapshot, not a claim about census municipal totals. ORP and city boroughs are separate optional views.
processing: Full available source resolution retained, cleaned together and rounded to six decimal places. Shared internal edges stored once; unselected coasts have no stroke. Deeper geometry loads only for the selected region. All views use the shared regional renderer, selected-outline index, adaptive detail, lifecycle and three-country cache. Territorial waters are excluded from land fills. Territory context features carry their own destination bounds. The local mesh is simplified together at two metres; district and region outlines are dissolved from it. Complete national arcs are anchored at verified survey tripoints; original surveys and independent junction evidence are retained.
